title: XMIntake API Submission Payload
description: Payload sent from XMIntake app to custom API destinations.

$schema.description: URL of the data schema used for validation (equals the $id of the schema).

upload_triggered_at.description: UTC timestamp when the user triggered the upload (ISO 8601).

data.description: Flat key-value map of field IDs to values.

additionalProperties.description: Field value. Dates are represented as strings.

attachments.description: List of file attachments associated with fields.

field_name.description: Field ID this attachment belongs to.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g. image/jpeg, application/pdf).

url.description: URL to access the file (e.g. Google Drive or other storage).
